name: VfxShotTracker
tagline: Bids, awards, versions, client notes and delivery for every VFX shot – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete VFX production module for Canvas, model-driven and Power Pages: shot breakdown with frame ranges and budgets, vendor bid comparison and award, plate turnover, version submissions, client review notes, approval, technical check and delivery, with budget-tolerance, review-SLA, version-creep and vendor-capacity rules.
features: Rule-checked status workflow with drag & drop, keyboard moves and undo
Side-by-side vendor bid comparison against budget with one-click award
Review queue with version history, quick notes and NoteJson output for vendor flows
Budget variance, vendor load vs capacity and due-date KPIs
Bulk status, bulk tech check and CSV export
Phone layout with status chips and bottom view bar
